senses.en: a return on a shot that seemed impossible to reach and would normally have resulted in a point for the opponent
senses.zh: 似乎无法到达的镜头的回转 通常会导致对手的点数

senses.en: come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
senses.zh: 掌握着一些具体或抽象的东西

examples.en: She got a lot of paintings from her uncle
examples.zh: 她从舅舅那里得到很多画作

examples.en: They acquired a new pet
Get your results the next day
Get permission to take a few days off from work

senses.en: enter or assume a certain state or condition

examples.en: He became annoyed when he heard the bad news
examples.zh: 听到坏消息后,他变得很生气

examples.en: It must be getting more serious
her face went red with anger
She went into ecstasy
Get going!

senses.en: cause to move; cause to be in a certain position or condition
senses.zh: 动因; 处于某种位置或状态

examples.en: He got his squad on the ball
This let me in for a big surprise
He got a girl into trouble
examples.zh: 他让一个女孩惹上麻烦了

senses.en: receive a specified treatment (abstract)

examples.en: These aspects of civilization do not find expression or receive an interpretation
examples.zh: 文明的这些方面并没有得到表达或解释

examples.en: His movie received a good review
I got nothing but trouble for my good intentions
examples.zh: 我为我的好意而无所顾忌

senses.en: reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
senses.zh: 到达目的地;通过移动或进度抵达

examples.en: She arrived home at 7 o'clock
She didn't get to Chicago until after midnight

senses.en: go or come after and bring or take back
senses.zh: 要么去要么去追 要么去带 要么回

examples.en: Get me those books over there, please
Could you bring the wine?
The dog fetched the hat

senses.en: go through (mental or physical states or experiences)
senses.zh: 经历(心理或身体状态或经历)

examples.en: get an idea
experience vertigo
get nauseous
receive injuries
have a feeling

senses.en: take vengeance on or get even

examples.en: We'll get them!
That'll fix him good!
This time I got him

senses.en: achieve a point or goal

examples.en: Nicklaus had a 70
The Brazilian team got 4 goals
She made 29 points that day

senses.en: cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
senses.zh: 理由; 以特定方式行事的理由

examples.en: The ads induced me to buy a VCR
examples.zh: 广告让我买了一台录像机

examples.en: My children finally got me to buy a computer
examples.zh: 我的孩子终于让我买了一台电脑

examples.en: My wife made me buy a new sofa

senses.en: succeed in catching or seizing, especially after a chase
senses.zh: 成功捕捉或抓获,特别是在追逐之后

examples.en: We finally got the suspect
Did you catch the thief?

senses.en: come to have or undergo a change of (physical features and attributes)
senses.zh: 拥有或经历变化(物理特征和属性)

examples.en: He grew a beard
The patient developed abdominal pains
I got funny spots all over my body
examples.zh: 我全身都是些有趣的斑点

examples.en: Well-developed breasts

senses.en: be stricken by an illness, fall victim to an illness
senses.zh: 受疾病之苦,成为疾病的受害者

examples.en: He got AIDS
examples.zh: 他得了艾滋,他得了艾滋,你觉得呢?

examples.en: She came down with pneumonia
She took a chill

senses.en: communicate with a place or person; establish communication with, as if by telephone
senses.zh: 与地点或个人进行联系; 与他人建立联系,如通过电话联系;

examples.en: Bill called this number and he got Mary
examples.zh: 比尔打这个电话,他把玛丽给打了

examples.en: The operator couldn't get Kobe because of the earthquake
examples.zh: 接线员因为地震无法接走神户

senses.en: give certain properties to something

examples.en: get someone mad
She made us look silly
He made a fool of himself at the meeting
Don't make this into a big deal
This invention will make you a millionaire
examples.zh: 这个发明会让你成为百万富翁

examples.en: Make yourself clear

senses.en: move into a desired direction of discourse

examples.en: What are you driving at?

senses.en: grasp with the mind or develop an understanding of

examples.en: did you catch that allusion?
We caught something of his theory in the lecture
examples.zh: 我们在演讲中发现了他的理论

examples.en: don't catch your meaning
did you get it?
She didn't get the joke
I just don't get him

senses.en: attract and fix

examples.en: His look caught her
examples.zh: 他的外表抓住她了,我看见她了

examples.en: She caught his eye
examples.zh: 她抓住了他的眼睛,他的眼睛,他的眼睛被他吸引了起来

examples.en: Catch the attention of the waiter

senses.en: reach with a blow or hit in a particular spot

examples.en: the rock caught her in the back of the head
The blow got him in the back
The punch caught him in the stomach

senses.en: reach by calculation

examples.en: What do you get when you add up these numbers?

senses.en: acquire as a result of some effort or action
senses.zh: 通过某种努力或行动获得的

examples.en: You cannot get water out of a stone
Where did she get these news?
examples.zh: 她从哪里得到这些消息的?

senses.en: purchase

examples.en: What did you get at the toy store?
examples.zh: 你在玩具店买到什么了?

senses.en: perceive by hearing

examples.en: I didn't catch your name
examples.zh: 我听不懂你的名字,你叫什麽名字?

examples.en: She didn't get his name when they met the first time
examples.zh: 第一次见面时她不知道他的名字

senses.en: suffer from the receipt of

examples.en: She will catch hell for this behavior!
examples.zh: 她会因为这种行为而下地狱的!

senses.en: receive as a retribution or punishment
senses.zh: 以报复或惩罚方式接受处罚

examples.en: He got 5 years in prison

senses.en: leave immediately; used usually in the imperative form
senses.zh: 立即离开; 通常使用强制形式

examples.en: Scram!

senses.en: reach and board

examples.en: She got the bus just as it was leaving
examples.zh: 她得到了公交车,就像它离开。

senses.en: irritate

examples.en: Her childish behavior really get to me
examples.zh: 她的幼稚行为真的让我感动

examples.en: His lying really gets me

senses.en: evoke an emotional response

examples.en: Brahms's `Requiem' gets me every time
examples.zh: 勃拉姆斯的"复仇"每次都让我

senses.en: apprehend and reproduce accurately

examples.en: She really caught the spirit of the place in her drawings
examples.zh: 她真的在画里 抓住了这里的精神

examples.en: She got the mood just right in her photographs
examples.zh: 她的心情正好出现在她的照片里

senses.en: earn or achieve a base by being walked by the pitcher
senses.zh: 通过投球手的行走来挣钱或取得一个基础

examples.en: He drew a base on balls

senses.en: overcome or destroy

examples.en: The ice storm got my hibiscus
the cat got the goldfish

senses.en: be a mystery or bewildering to
senses.zh: 成为神秘或困惑的到来

examples.en: This beats me!
Got me--I don't know the answer!
examples.zh: 我得到了 -我不知道答案!

examples.en: a vexing problem
This question really stuck me

senses.en: take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
senses.zh: 开始行动；采取最初的一步或几步。

examples.en: We began working at dawn
examples.zh: 我们天亮就开始工作了

examples.en: Who will start?
Get working as soon as the sun rises!
examples.zh: 太阳一升起就开始工作!

examples.en: The first tourists began to arrive in Cambodia
examples.zh: 第一批游客开始抵达柬埔寨

examples.en: He began early in the day
Let's get down to work now

senses.en: undergo (as of injuries and illnesses)

examples.en: She suffered a fracture in the accident
He had an insulin shock after eating three candy bars
examples.zh: 吃了三块糖条后,他得了胰岛素休克症

examples.en: She got a bruise on her leg
He got his arm broken in the scuffle

senses.en: make children

examples.en: Abraham begot Isaac
Men often father children but don't recognize them
examples.zh: 男人常常生孩子,却认不出他们
